acceptanceCriteria: A dispatched session killed mid-run leaves no orphaned pool allocation: the dispatcher releases it on attempt end (test)
`dispatch status` shows held allocations per attempt (test)
Existing waiter ordering (grace, then priority, then arrival) is preserved (test)
Spec requirements added in PSR/ATR with traces; focused internal/tasks/dispatch and cli tests pass
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1147 (owner, 2026-10-18). A ticket whose session needs a pool member must currently acquire it from inside the session. If the worker ends (context limit, crash, budget stop) while that acquire is in flight, the allocation is abandoned and stays allocated or quarantined until a sweep. Expected: for a ticket that declares a pool requirement, the dispatcher acquires the member before launch, hands the allocation to the session (env or handoff file), and releases it when the attempt ends, whatever the session did. Related, not duplicated: V1-1573 (acquire at claim time, a follow-up of capacity slots) and V1-0800 (requiresPool omitted). New requirements belong in the pool-safe-reuse (PSR) or attempt-runner (ATR) spec, not the leases spec, which is over its bound.
title: dispatch: acquire and hold the pool member for a session that needs one; release it on attempt end (GitHub #1147)
